name: SikaFiber-100 Recycled PP48 Impact
paste:
SIKAFIBER®-100 RECYCLED PP48 IMPACT: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: SikaFiber®-100 Recycled PP48 Impact, June 2026, Version 01.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sikafiber-100-recycledpp48impact.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide SikaFiber®-100 Recycled PP48 Impact where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2026, Version 01.01).
1.2 Product description. SikaFiber®-100 Recycled PP48 Impact is a 100% recycled polypropylene macro structural fiber that delivers optimum performance in highly corrosive environments. It is suited in pre-cast, slabs on ground among many other applications. This product achieves high Fr values (residual flexural strength based on EN 14651 testing) and enhanced toughness values (based on ASTM 1550) in slabs on grade and shotcrete applications.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - ▪ Shotcrete
    - ▪ Ground supported slabs
    - ▪ Precast elements
    - ▪ Industrial flooring
    - ▪ Sea defense
    - ▪ Airport & pavements
    - ▪ Slope stabilization
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. SikaFiber®-100 Recycled PP48 Impact
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Australian made recycled polypropylene macro fibers
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer - Sustainably Impactful.
    - SikaFiber®-100 Recycled PP48 Impact is an innovative plastic macro structural fiber produced in Australia using post-industrial recycled materials, offering our customers a sustainable solution that supports reducing our carbon footprint.
    - For more information, see Sustainability Fact Sheet.
2.3 Certificates and test reports.
    - SikaFiber®-100 Recycled PP48 Impact conforms to
    - EN 14889-2: 2006, and to ASTM 1116 Type III
2.4 Standards and test methods cited in the data sheet. Cited as written in the data sheet. A citation is not a statement that the product complies with it; conformity is stated only where the data sheet says so (see the approvals clause and the statements quoted in the other clauses).
    - EN 14651: cited elsewhere in the data sheet. Where: Description (p.1).
    - EN 14889-2: 2006: cited elsewhere in the data sheet; listed under approvals, certificates or standards. Where: Certificates And Test Reports (p.1); Specification Information (p.2).
2.5 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer.
    - Increases concrete toughness, impact resistance, and ductility
    - Decreases the tendency to cracking in both fresh and hardened state of the concrete
    - Reduces mechanical wear on pumps and pipelines
    - High resistance to chemical attacks and alkalis
    - It is safer and easier to use than traditional reinforcement
    - Does not corrode in aggressive waters
    - Saves time and processes during the application and construction process of the concrete element
    - Australian made
2.6 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Recycled polypropylene
    - Colour: Grey
2.7 Properties stated by the manufacturer.
    - Length: Average Length: 48 mm
    - Width: Mean Width: 1.35 mm
    - Tensile strength: > 450 MPa
2.8 Specification information. Fibres for concrete shall be SikaFiber®-100 Recycled PP48 Impact, 100% recycled polypropylene high-performance macro fibre conforming to EN 14889-2: 2006 Class II and manufactured specifically for the reinforcement of concrete. SikaFiber®-100 Recycled PP48 Impact macro-synthetic fibres shall be mixed at the batch plant, at the recommended rate of 4-8 kg per cubic metre, and mixed for sufficient time (minimum 5 minutes) to ensure even distribution of the fibres throughout the concrete mix.
2.9 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Shelf life: NA
    - Storage conditions: Store protected from the weather
2.10 Packaging. Environment-friendly recycled and biodegradable 5 kg carton boxes- fibers wrapped in water soluble plastic pucks (Parallel Packed). Entire package can be thrown into the mix allowing for easy handling whilst leaving no waste on site. 200 boxes per pallet.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2026, Version 01.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (June 2026, Version 01.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Thickness: Mean Thickness: 0.45 mm
    - Recommended dosage: 4-8 kg/m³
    - Compatibility: SikaFiber®-100 Recycled PP48 Impact is compatible with all concrete admixtures and performance enhancing chemicals.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations. The addition of SikaFiber®-100 Recycled PP48 Impact might cause a reduction in the concrete workability. We recommend correcting this loss not by adding more water, but by adjusting the mix to the required consistency with a suitable dosage of a Sika® ViscoCrete® or SikaPlast® admixture.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (June 2026, Version 01.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: SikaFiber®-100 Recycled PP48 Impact, June 2026, Version 01.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/c/sikafiber-100-recycledpp48impact.pdf
    - Document: SikaFiber-100 Recycled PP48 Impact - Sustainability Fact Sheet, version 03/06/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/8/sikafiber-100-recycledpp48impact-sustainabilityfactsheet.pdf
    - Brochure: Sika Fibre Solutions 2026 v1, version 05/06/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/i/Sika%20Fibre%20-%20A4%202025%20FIN%20DIGI.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Ecology, health and safety - Dispensing. SikaFiber®-100 Recycled PP48 Impact is uniquely designed and packaged for even dispersion through the matrix, preventing balling and pumping issues. It can be added at any stage of batching. Mix for 5 minutes at mixing speed to ensure full fiber dispersion.
6.4 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
